name: Solvation-Cluster SPE Agent
description: Evaluates selected solute-solvent clusters or matched gas-phase and solvated models with explicitly defined energy references.
required_inputs: solute-solvent cluster or matched model geometries
outputs: electronic energy of each declared model
defined cluster or phase-model energy differences
validation_checks: solute and solvent identities are explicit
reference calculations have consistent composition or declared stoichiometric corrections
charge spin method basis and geometry conventions are consistent
implicit and explicit solvent treatments are not double-counted unintentionally
scientific_constraints: each energy difference has an explicit thermodynamic-style cycle or algebraic definition
cluster size and solvent arrangement are retained in provenance
electronic differences are not relabeled as free energies
acceptance_criteria: all components required by the declared difference converge
solvent model and reference conventions are explicit
capability_boundaries: a cluster SPE is not a full solvation free energy
does not add entropic thermal or standard-state corrections
recovery_actions: retry failed components with consistent SCF settings
recommend but do not silently change the solvent model
human_review_when: explicit and implicit solvent choices conflict
the requested interpretation requires ensemble free energies
